title: Zephyrine and the Will
author: Hazel Sterling
blurb: Freya Joubert, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
